title: Remote job query
description: Filter current listings from public remote-job feeds.

sources.title: Sources
sources.description: Public feeds to query; no login or proxy is required.

keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: All keywords must occur in the normalized listing text.

locations.title: Locations

maxAgeDays.title: Maximum age (days)

includeDescription.title: Include descriptions
